description: Escape in a filled text field keeps the panel open silently, while Escape on a select (or an empty field) closes the whole panel.
expected: One rule for Escape inside the editor, e.g. Escape never closes the panel while an editor is open, or it always closes and keeps the draft with a cue.
actual: Panel stays from textarea, closes from Priority select
suggested_fix: Apply escapeKeepsPanel to any focus inside an open edit form, not only to non-empty text fields.

description: The New task draft lives only in memory and is lost on reload, while edit drafts persist in sessionStorage. A person who reloads mid-create loses the typed title with no notice.
expected: New task drafts persist like edit drafts, or the app warns before unload.
actual: After reload the New task panel is gone and the title is lost
suggested_fix: Persist the New task draft with the same draft storage key scheme (per workspace and Actor).

description: When the panel reopens into a restored draft (after Close or reload), nothing says it is an unsaved draft. The summary line still shows the saved values (e.g. P2) while the editor holds P1.
expected: A small 'Unsaved draft from earlier' cue with Discard, and optionally a draft marker on the card.
actual: The editor opens silently with draft values
suggested_fix: Show a draft-restored note in the editor header when the draft came from storage.

criterion: One way per task / competing forms
description: Hand off work stays enabled while the edit form is open. Clicking it stacks the handoff form under the editor, so status and assignee are editable in two forms at once and it is unclear which save wins.
expected: One editing mode at a time: hide or disable Hand off work while editing, or ask to save/discard the edit first.
actual: Editor and handoff form both open, each with a Status field
suggested_fix: Hide Hand off work while the editor is open (and Edit task while handoff is open).
